summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 4 new enhancements (Z-отчёт, курсовая подача, история долга, экспорт CSV) plus POS regression. 3 of 4 features work fully. CRITICAL: the Z-report modal NEVER appears right after closing a shift — it only surfaces (stale) after the NEXT shift is opened, where it also blocks table clicks. Per-course kitchen tickets, debt history modal and all CSV exports work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Закрыть смену' the shift closes (toast 'Смена закрыта. Выручка: 30.60 ₽') but [data-testid=z-report-modal] count = 0 — modal is never rendered. Cause: the `if (shift === null) return (...)` early-return branch (~L324-347) renders BEFORE the zReport JSX (~L889), so once refetchShift() sets shift=null the Z modal markup is unmounted/never reached. Verified twice (empty shift and shift with 2 sales).

Because zReport state is never cleared, the previous shift's Z-report modal pops up immediately AFTER the user opens the NEXT shift and its full-screen overlay (z-[70]) intercepts pointer events — table buttons cannot be clicked until it is manually closed. Playwright click on pos-table-* was blocked by <div class="fixed inset-0 z-[70] ...">.
Transaction sub-label shows the raw payment-method code ('2026-08-27 00:16 · cash', '· debt') instead of the localized method name (Наличные/В долг). Russian UI consistency.

issues: Leftover test data from earlier iterations visible in Маржинальность (product 'TEST_Блюдо_214934' with 0 cost / 100% margin) — consider cleanup of seeded TEST_ rows
Seed data oddity: 'Греческий салат' is assigned to workshop 'Бар', so course-1 salad prints on the bar ticket (not a code defect, but demo data looks wrong)

action_items: Pos.jsx: render the Z-report modal outside/above the `shift === null` early return (e.g. extract <ZReportModal/> and include it in BOTH branches) so it auto-appears right after closing the shift.
Pos.jsx: clear zReport (setZReport(null)) inside openShift() so a stale Z-report never blocks the new shift's table screen.
Optional: localize payment-method code in the debt-history rows (cash/debt -> Наличные/В долг).
Optional: wrap the `api.post(/orders/{id}/send)` call in sendKitchen() with try/catch — an error there currently rejects unhandled (no toast).
critical_code_review_comments: Pos.jsx is ~990 lines with 8+ inline modals; the early-return-for-no-shift pattern is exactly what broke the Z-report. Split modals into components rendered from a single root to avoid this class of bug.
sendKitchen() has no try/catch unlike every other mutation handler — inconsistent error handling.

rca_of_the_issue: closeShift() sets zReport and calls refetchShift(); shift becomes null, and Pos() then hits `if (shift === null) return (<no-shift screen/>)` which is declared before the zReport modal JSX. The Z modal therefore never mounts on close; it mounts only once a shift exists again (after 'Открыть смену'), showing the previous shift's data and blocking clicks via its fixed z-[70] overlay. Fix: hoist the Z modal above the early return and reset zReport in openShift().
